```{r load-packages}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(MASS)
library(sandwich)
```

```{r set-paths}
project_dir <- "E:/dissertation/output"
data_dir <- "E:/dissertation/datasets"

traffic_file <- file.path(data_dir, "dft_traffic_counts_aadf.csv")
stats19_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "stats19_complete_official")
collision_file <- file.path(
  stats19_dir,
  "dft-road-casualty-statistics-collision-1979-latest-published-year.csv"
)
vehicle_file <- file.path(
  stats19_dir,
  "dft-road-casualty-statistics-vehicle-1979-latest-published-year.csv"
)

clean_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "Cleaned data")
analysis_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "Model analysis output")
histogram_dir <- file.path(clean_dir, "histograms")
figure_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "figures")

dir.create(clean_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(analysis_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(histogram_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(figure_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

years <- 2017:2024
gm_local_authorities <- c(
  "Bolton", "Bury", "Manchester", "Oldham", "Rochdale",
  "Salford", "Stockport", "Tameside", "Trafford", "Wigan"
)
```

```{r clean-traffic}
traffic_raw <- read_csv(traffic_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

traffic_clean <- traffic_raw %>%
  mutate(
    road_name = str_to_upper(road_name),
    road_name = str_replace_all(road_name, "\\s+", ""),
    road_type_simple = case_when(
      str_detect(road_name, "^M") ~ "Motorway",
      str_detect(road_name, "^A") ~ "A road",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    lgv_share = LGVs / all_motor_vehicles
  ) %>%
  filter(
    year %in% years,
    local_authority_name %in% gm_local_authorities,
    road_type_simple %in% c("Motorway", "A road"),
    !is.na(road_name),
    !is.na(all_motor_vehicles),
    all_motor_vehicles > 0
  )

write_csv(
  traffic_clean,
  file.path(clean_dir, "traffic_clean_gm_major_2017_2024.csv")
)

nrow(traffic_clean)

rm(traffic_raw)
invisible(gc())
```

```{r aggregate-traffic}
road_length_data <- traffic_clean %>%
  distinct(road_name, year, count_point_id, link_length_km) %>%
  group_by(road_name, year) %>%
  summarise(
    road_length_km = sum(link_length_km, na.rm = TRUE),
    count_points = n_distinct(count_point_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    road_length_km = if_else(road_length_km <= 0, NA_real_, road_length_km),
    log_road_length = log(road_length_km)
  )

traffic_road_year <- traffic_clean %>%
  group_by(road_name, year) %>%
  summarise(
    road_type = if_else(
      any(road_type_simple == "Motorway"),
      "Motorway",
      "A road"
    ),
    all_motor_vehicles = mean(all_motor_vehicles, na.rm = TRUE),
    LGVs = mean(LGVs, na.rm = TRUE),
    all_HGVs = mean(all_HGVs, na.rm = TRUE),
    cars_and_taxis = mean(cars_and_taxis, na.rm = TRUE),
    lgv_share = mean(lgv_share, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(road_length_data, by = c("road_name", "year")) %>%
  mutate(log_total_traffic = log(all_motor_vehicles))

write_csv(
  traffic_road_year,
  file.path(clean_dir, "traffic_road_year_with_length.csv")
)

traffic_road_year %>%
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    missing_road_length = sum(is.na(road_length_km)),
    mean_road_length_km = mean(road_length_km, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r clean-collisions}
collisions_raw <- read_csv(
  collision_file,
  col_select = c(
    collision_index,
    collision_year,
    collision_ref_no,
    police_force,
    collision_severity,
    first_road_class,
    first_road_number,
    time,
    speed_limit,
    junction_detail
  ),
  col_types = cols(
    .default = col_guess(),
    collision_index = col_character(),
    collision_ref_no = col_character()
  )
)

collisions_clean <- collisions_raw %>%
  mutate(
    collision_year = as.integer(collision_year),
    collision_ref_join = str_pad(
      collision_ref_no,
      width = 9,
      side = "left",
      pad = "0"
    ),
    first_road_class = as.integer(first_road_class),
    first_road_number = as.integer(first_road_number),
    road_name = case_when(
      first_road_class == 1 ~ paste0("M", first_road_number),
      first_road_class == 2 ~ paste0("A", first_road_number, "(M)"),
      first_road_class == 3 ~ paste0("A", first_road_number),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    road_name = str_to_upper(road_name),
    road_type = case_when(
      str_detect(road_name, "^M") ~ "Motorway",
      str_detect(road_name, "^A") ~ "A road",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    severity_text = case_when(
      collision_severity == 1 ~ "fatal",
      collision_severity == 2 ~ "serious",
      collision_severity == 3 ~ "slight",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    severe = case_when(
      collision_severity %in% c(1, 2) ~ 1,
      collision_severity == 3 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    collision_hour = as.integer(substr(time, 1, 2)),
    time_period = case_when(
      collision_hour >= 7 & collision_hour <= 9 ~ "morning_peak",
      collision_hour >= 10 & collision_hour <= 15 ~ "daytime",
      collision_hour >= 16 & collision_hour <= 18 ~ "evening_peak",
      !is.na(collision_hour) ~ "night_or_off_peak",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    speed_group = case_when(
      speed_limit <= 30 ~ "30 mph or below",
      speed_limit >= 40 ~ "40 mph or above",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    junction_group = case_when(
      junction_detail == 0 ~ "No junction",
      junction_detail == 13 ~ "T or staggered junction",
      junction_detail %in% c(16, 17) ~ "Crossroads or larger junction",
      junction_detail %in% c(18, 19, 99, -1) ~ "Other or unknown junction",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    collision_year %in% years,
    police_force == 6,
    road_type %in% c("Motorway", "A road"),
    !is.na(road_name)
  )

write_csv(
  collisions_clean,
  file.path(clean_dir, "collisions_clean_gm_major_2017_2024.csv")
)

nrow(collisions_clean)

rm(collisions_raw)
invisible(gc())
```

```{r aggregate-collisions}
collision_counts <- collisions_clean %>%
  group_by(road_name, year = collision_year) %>%
  summarise(
    collision_count = n(),
    fatal_count = sum(collision_severity == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    serious_count = sum(collision_severity == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    slight_count = sum(collision_severity == 3, na.rm = TRUE),
    severe_count = sum(collision_severity %in% c(1, 2), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

frequency_model_data <- traffic_road_year %>%
  left_join(collision_counts, by = c("road_name", "year")) %>%
  mutate(
    collision_count = replace_na(collision_count, 0),
    fatal_count = replace_na(fatal_count, 0),
    serious_count = replace_na(serious_count, 0),
    slight_count = replace_na(slight_count, 0),
    severe_count = replace_na(severe_count, 0)
  )

write_csv(
  frequency_model_data,
  file.path(clean_dir, "frequency_model_data_with_road_length.csv")
)

frequency_model_data %>%
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    total_collision_count = sum(collision_count),
    missing_lgv_share = sum(is.na(lgv_share)),
    missing_log_total_traffic = sum(is.na(log_total_traffic)),
    missing_road_length = sum(is.na(road_length_km)),
    missing_log_road_length = sum(is.na(log_road_length))
  )

rm(traffic_clean, road_length_data, traffic_road_year, collision_counts)
invisible(gc())
```

```{r clean-vehicles}
vehicles_raw <- read_csv(
  vehicle_file,
  col_select = c(
    collision_index,
    collision_ref_no,
    collision_year,
    vehicle_type,
    age_of_driver
  ),
  col_types = cols(
    collision_index = col_character(),
    collision_ref_no = col_character(),
    collision_year = col_integer(),
    vehicle_type = col_integer(),
    age_of_driver = col_double()
  ),
  num_threads = 1
)

vehicles_clean <- vehicles_raw %>%
  mutate(
    collision_year = as.integer(collision_year),
    collision_ref_join = str_pad(
      collision_ref_no,
      width = 9,
      side = "left",
      pad = "0"
    ),
    vehicle_type = as.integer(vehicle_type),
    age_of_driver = as.numeric(age_of_driver),
    is_lgv = if_else(vehicle_type == 19, 1, 0),
    young_driver = case_when(
      age_of_driver >= 0 & age_of_driver < 25 ~ 1,
      age_of_driver >= 25 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(collision_year %in% years)

vehicle_flags <- vehicles_clean %>%
  group_by(collision_ref_join, collision_year) %>%
  summarise(
    lgv_involved = max(is_lgv, na.rm = TRUE),
    young_driver_involved = if_else(
      all(is.na(young_driver)),
      NA_real_,
      max(young_driver, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(
  vehicle_flags,
  file.path(clean_dir, "vehicle_flags_lgv_young_driver.csv")
)

vehicle_flags %>%
  summarise(
    lgv_involved_collisions = sum(lgv_involved == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    young_driver_involved_collisions = sum(
      young_driver_involved == 1,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

rm(vehicles_raw, vehicles_clean)
invisible(gc())
```

```{r build-model-data}
severity_joined_data <- collisions_clean %>%
  left_join(vehicle_flags, by = c("collision_ref_join", "collision_year"))

vehicle_match_check <- severity_joined_data %>%
  summarise(
    collision_observations = n(),
    matched_lgv_flag = sum(!is.na(lgv_involved)),
    matched_young_driver_flag = sum(!is.na(young_driver_involved)),
    lgv_match_rate = mean(!is.na(lgv_involved)),
    young_driver_match_rate = mean(!is.na(young_driver_involved))
  )

write_csv(
  vehicle_match_check,
  file.path(clean_dir, "collision_vehicle_match_check.csv")
)

vehicle_match_check

severity_model_data <- severity_joined_data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(severe),
    !is.na(lgv_involved),
    !is.na(young_driver_involved),
    !is.na(time_period),
    !is.na(speed_group),
    !is.na(junction_group),
    !is.na(road_type)
  )

write_csv(
  severity_model_data,
  file.path(clean_dir, "severity_model_data_with_controls.csv")
)

severity_model_data %>%
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    severe_collisions = sum(severe == 1),
    slight_collisions = sum(severe == 0),
    lgv_involved_collisions = sum(lgv_involved == 1),
    young_driver_involved_collisions = sum(young_driver_involved == 1),
    speed_groups = n_distinct(speed_group),
    junction_groups = n_distinct(junction_group)
  )
```

```{r check-severity-groups}
severity_model_data %>%
  count(speed_group, severe, name = "collisions") %>%
  arrange(speed_group, severe)

severity_model_data %>%
  count(junction_group, name = "collisions") %>%
  arrange(junction_group)
```



```{r prepare-analysis}
frequency_file <- file.path(
  clean_dir,
  "frequency_model_data_with_road_length.csv"
)
severity_file <- file.path(
  clean_dir,
  "severity_model_data_with_controls.csv"
)

frequency_data <- read_csv(frequency_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    lgv_share_10pp = lgv_share * 10,
    road_type = factor(road_type, levels = c("A road", "Motorway")),
    year = factor(as.character(year), levels = as.character(years))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(collision_count),
    !is.na(lgv_share_10pp),
    !is.na(log_total_traffic),
    !is.na(log_road_length),
    !is.na(road_type),
    !is.na(year),
    !is.na(road_name)
  )

severity_data <- read_csv(severity_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    lgv_involved = factor(lgv_involved, levels = c(0, 1)),
    young_driver_involved = factor(young_driver_involved, levels = c(0, 1)),
    road_type = factor(road_type, levels = c("A road", "Motorway")),
    time_period = factor(
      time_period,
      levels = c(
        "morning_peak",
        "daytime",
        "evening_peak",
        "night_or_off_peak"
      )
    ),
    speed_group = case_when(
      as.numeric(as.character(speed_limit)) <= 30 ~ "30 mph or below",
      as.numeric(as.character(speed_limit)) >= 40 ~ "40 mph or above",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    speed_group = factor(
      speed_group,
      levels = c("30 mph or below", "40 mph or above")
    ),
    junction_group = factor(
      junction_group,
      levels = c(
        "No junction",
        "T or staggered junction",
        "Crossroads or larger junction",
        "Other or unknown junction"
      )
    ),
    collision_year = factor(
      as.character(collision_year),
      levels = as.character(years)
    )
  )

sample_checks <- data.frame(
  measure = c(
    "Frequency model observations",
    "Total collisions in frequency data",
    "Severity model observations",
    "Severe collisions in severity data",
    "LGV-involved collisions in severity data"
  ),
  value = c(
    nrow(frequency_data),
    sum(frequency_data$collision_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    nrow(severity_data),
    sum(severity_data$severe == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(severity_data$lgv_involved == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)

write_csv(
  sample_checks,
  file.path(analysis_dir, "sample_checks_from_analysis.csv")
)
```

```{r define-model-table}
make_model_table <- function(
  model,
  cluster_variable,
  model_name,
  effect_label
) {
  robust_vcov <- vcovCL(
    model,
    cluster = cluster_variable,
    type = "HC1"
  )

  estimate <- coef(model)
  robust_se <- sqrt(diag(robust_vcov))
  statistic <- estimate / robust_se
  p_value <- 2 * pnorm(abs(statistic), lower.tail = FALSE)

  data.frame(
    model = model_name,
    term = names(estimate),
    estimate = as.numeric(estimate),
    robust_std_error = as.numeric(robust_se),
    statistic = as.numeric(statistic),
    p_value = as.numeric(p_value),
    exp_estimate = exp(as.numeric(estimate)),
    exp_low_95 = exp(as.numeric(estimate) - 1.96 * robust_se),
    exp_high_95 = exp(as.numeric(estimate) + 1.96 * robust_se),
    effect_label = effect_label,
    row.names = NULL
  )
}
```

```{r fit-frequency-model-one}
frequency_model_1 <- glm.nb(
  collision_count ~ lgv_share_10pp,
  data = frequency_data
)

frequency_model_1_results <- make_model_table(
  frequency_model_1,
  frequency_data$road_name,
  "Model 1: unadjusted collision frequency",
  "IRR"
)

summary(frequency_model_1)
frequency_model_1_results

write_csv(
  frequency_model_1_results,
  file.path(analysis_dir, "model_1_unadjusted_frequency_results.csv")
)
```

```{r fit-frequency-model-two}
frequency_model_2 <- glm.nb(
  collision_count ~
    lgv_share_10pp +
    log_total_traffic +
    log_road_length +
    road_type +
    year,
  data = frequency_data
)

frequency_model_2_results <- make_model_table(
  frequency_model_2,
  frequency_data$road_name,
  "Model 2: adjusted collision frequency",
  "IRR"
)

summary(frequency_model_2)
frequency_model_2_results

write_csv(

)
```

```{r frequency-diagnostics}
poisson_model_2 <- glm(
  collision_count ~
    lgv_share_10pp +
    log_total_traffic +
    log_road_length +
    road_type +
    year,
  family = poisson(link = "log"),
  data = frequency_data
)

overdispersion_ratio_model_2 <-
  sum(residuals(poisson_model_2, type = "pearson")^2) /
  df.residual(poisson_model_2)

frequency_diagnostics <- data.frame(
  model = c(
    "Poisson version of Model 2",
    "Negative Binomial Model 2"
  ),
  observations = c(nobs(poisson_model_2), nobs(frequency_model_2)),
  AIC = c(AIC(poisson_model_2), AIC(frequency_model_2)),
  pearson_overdispersion_ratio = c(
    overdispersion_ratio_model_2,
    NA_real_
  ),
  NB_theta = c(NA_real_, frequency_model_2$theta)
)

frequency_model_comparison <- bind_rows(
  frequency_model_1_results,
  frequency_model_2_results
) %>%
  filter(term == "lgv_share_10pp") %>%
  dplyr::select(
    model,
    term,
    estimate,
    robust_std_error,
    exp_estimate,
    exp_low_95,
    exp_high_95,
    p_value,
    effect_label
  )

frequency_diagnostics
frequency_model_comparison

write_csv(
  frequency_diagnostics,
  file.path(analysis_dir, "frequency_model_diagnostics.csv")
)
write_csv(
  frequency_model_comparison,
  file.path(analysis_dir, "model_1_vs_model_2_lgv_share_comparison.csv")
)
```

```{r fit-severity-model}
severity_model <- glm(
  severe ~
    lgv_involved +
    young_driver_involved +
    time_period +
    factor(speed_group) +
    factor(junction_group) +
    factor(road_type) +
    factor(collision_year),
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  data = severity_data
)

severity_model_results <- make_model_table(
  severity_model,
  severity_data$road_name,
  "Model 3: collision severity model",
  "OR"
)

summary(severity_model)
severity_model_results

write_csv(
  severity_model_results,
  file.path(analysis_dir, "model_3_collision_severity_results.csv")
)
```

```{r compile-model-summary}
model_fit_summary <- data.frame(
  model = c(
    "Model 1: unadjusted collision frequency",
    "Model 2: adjusted collision frequency",
    "Model 3: collision severity model"
  ),
  model_type = c(
    "Negative binomial",
    "Negative binomial",
    "Binary logistic regression"
  ),
  observations = c(
    nobs(frequency_model_1),
    nobs(frequency_model_2),
    nobs(severity_model)
  ),
  AIC = c(
    AIC(frequency_model_1),
    AIC(frequency_model_2),
    AIC(severity_model)
  )
)

key_results <- bind_rows(
  frequency_model_1_results,
  frequency_model_2_results,
  severity_model_results
) %>%
  filter(
    term %in% c(
      "lgv_share_10pp",
      "lgv_involved1",
      "young_driver_involved1"
    )
  )

model_fit_summary
key_results

write_csv(
  model_fit_summary,
  file.path(analysis_dir, "model_fit_summary.csv")
)
write_csv(
  key_results,
  file.path(analysis_dir, "key_model_results.csv")
)
```
